title: Various RDP improvements
description:
This set of patches brings various improvements to the dissecting of RDP:
* add some new egfx commands
* add preliminary support for the RDPDR channel
* add some links in drdynvc in create channel request / response packets

commits_data.title: rdp_drdynvc: add links for channel create messages
commits_data.message:
rdp_drdynvc: add links for channel create messages

This patch adds link fields in create channel request / response so that you can
navigate to the response or the request.

It also adds processing of the rdpdr channel (happening when it's transported on UDP).

commits_data.title: rdp_egfx: add support for watermark and protect surface commands
commits_data.message:
rdp_egfx: add support for watermark and protect surface commands

This patch adds support for the watermark and protect surface commands on the
egfx channel. These commands aren't officially documented but some researches
allowed to guess the meaning of the various fields.

commits_data.title: rdp: add initial support for the multiplexed rdpdr channel
commits_data.message:
rdp: add initial support for the multiplexed rdpdr channel

This patch adds preliminary support for the rdpdr channel as specified in MS-RDPEFS.
This channel multiplexes drive, serial port, com port, printer, and smartcard
redirection. This early contribution adds dissecting for some of the commands related
to drive redirection.
